portfolio.title: Selected Works
portfolio.subtitle: Recent Projects
portfolio.desc_center-control:
A high-performance, native desktop application engineered with Rust and Tauri v2, specifically tailored for educational centres, private schools, and tutoring hubs. Operating with a 100% Offline-First architecture, it ensures lightning-fast execution and minimal memory footprint (< 80MB RAM).

The system seamlessly integrates sub-100ms barcode attendance tracking, automated multi-tier pricing and tuition collection, smart instant messaging to parents via WhatsApp and Telegram Bot API, dynamic scheduling, comprehensive financial analytics with Excel export, and enterprise-grade security powered by hardware fingerprinting and anti-tamper clock guards.
portfolio.desc_flow-accounting:
A comprehensive, advanced ERP and Point-of-Sale (POS) management system designed for retail stores, wholesale exhibitions, and SMBs. Engineered with a 100% Offline-First architecture, it ensures ultra-fast local execution with guaranteed ACID transaction safety powered by Better-SQLite3 with WAL mode.

The system features built-in LAN sharing (Express 5) to connect multiple cashiers and mobile devices over internal Wi-Fi, an instant 'Privacy Mode' to mask sensitive figures, full shift & inventory auditing, multi-payment invoices, supplier/client statement tracking, and automatic Profit & Loss (P&L) reporting.
portfolio.desc_crm-system: Built with a robust Client-Server architecture for high performance. The system features strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) ensuring data confidentiality, alongside full support for handling large datasets and efficient Excel export/import capabilities.
portfolio.desc_quran-audio-platform: A Progressive Web App (PWA) specifically designed and developed to play Quran recitations for Sheikh Dr. Ahmed El-Saeed Mandour with a modern, lightning-fast interface. It allows users to browse recitations categorized by year or location, featuring instant search and a seamless listening experience via a custom audio player. The system supports Natural Sort algorithms for Surahs, full offline capabilities, and buttery-smooth, lag-free transitions between Dark and Light themes.
portfolio.desc_dustout-platform:
A high-converting e-commerce and interactive marketing platform built for a leading supplier of professional cleaning equipment. The platform combines a dual-mode commerce engine (direct purchasing & monthly rentals), an interactive slide-over cart, instant checkout with phone number validation, and an educational cleaning blog with interactive modal views.

It features a full-fledged Admin Dashboard for product and order management (CRUD), paired with multi-platform ad pixel integrations (Meta, TikTok, Snapchat Pixels, and Microsoft Clarity) supporting Advanced Matching for maximum tracking accuracy and conversion rates (ROAS).
portfolio.desc_supermarket-pos: A professional, comprehensive, and lightning-fast Desktop Application designed specifically for Point of Sale (POS) and store management. The system operates entirely offline to ensure maximum data security and speed. It seamlessly handles the complete business cycle—from cashier operations and inventory management to tracking client/supplier accounts, calculating shift earnings, and determining precise net profits, complete with direct thermal printer integration.
portfolio.desc_zamzam-system: A comprehensive, offline-first Desktop Application tailored for computer and electronics repair shops to digitize the entire repair workflow from device intake to handover. The system features a modern user interface, a robust ticketing system for precise status tracking, a dynamic analytics dashboard, and built-in invoice printing. Designed for high performance without internet dependency, it ensures maximum data security while offering one-click CSV database backups.
